subject: Red team: insurance confirmation, SLA exceptions, and evidence handover
messages:
From: CypherSec Sales <sales@cyphersec.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Red team engagement — SOW and insurance

Hi Avery / Marissa,

Thanks for the initial chat last week. Attached is our updated SOW (CypherSec_SOW_v2.pdf) and a copy of our current insurance certificate (CypherSec_Insurance_Certificate.pdf). Major points:

- Proposed window: 2026-02-22 to 2026-02-26 (in-scope app + infra).
- Evidence handling: we normally hand off raw artifacts via encrypted SFTP or provide an encrypted archive upload to a customer S3 bucket.
- Retention: artifacts retained for 90 days by default; can extend on request.
- SLA/exceptions: red team activities may require limited SLA carve-outs for scheduled outages and simulated denial-of-service checks; these are listed in section 4.2 of the SOW.

Questions for you:
1) Is the proposed week acceptable?
2) Do you require a specific evidence-transfer method (SFTP vs. direct S3 upload)?
3) Any special insurance/indemnity language required by your procurement/legal?

If helpful, happy to hop on a 30m call this week to walk through the SOW and evidence flow.

Best,
Ravi Kumar
Enterprise Sales
CypherSec
[Attachment: CypherSec_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW), CypherSec_Insurance_Certificate.pdf (COI)]

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: CypherSec Sales <sales@cyphersec.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Red team engagement — SOW and insurance

Ravi — thanks for the materials. A few clarifying items inline and next steps.

On Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 9:03 AM CypherSec Sales <sales@cyphersec.io> wrote:
> Thanks for the initial chat last week. Attached is our updated SOW...

A few asks from our side:
- Evidence transfer: we prefer a direct upload to our S3 bucket (customer-managed) with server-side encryption. If SFTP is easier, we need an automated lifecycle that deletes artifacts after 90 days and proof of transfer logs. Can you include a sample transfer manifest?
- Audit logging: we need per-step audit entries for tool usage and investigator identifiers (section 5 compliance). Is that available?
- SLA exceptions: we can accept narrow testing exceptions but cannot authorize simulated DoS without explicit approval from our platform team. Please mark any traffic-impacting activities clearly in the SOW and list an opt-in checklist.
- Indemnity/limit of liability: our legal team typically asks for a mutual indemnity and a liability cap tied to the contract value. If you have standard language you can share, please attach.

We have a customer (Acme Cloud / Olivia) that needs visibility on the evidence handling approach before we finalize dates — copied Olivia here.

Next steps: please respond to the evidence transfer and indemnity questions. If you can incorporate the transfer manifest template into the SOW, that will speed approvals. If not, propose a time and we will pull in legal.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Signature: Avery Johnson | Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference]

From: CypherSec Sales <sales@cyphersec.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Grant <olivia@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Red team engagement — SOW and insurance

Hi Avery — appreciate the detailed notes. Quick answers and proposals:

- Evidence transfer: we can support both options. For S3 uploads we will push a single encrypted tar.gz with a signed manifest (SHA256) and upload logs. We will provide a sample manifest (attached: evidence-transfer-proposal.txt) and the S3 object lifecycle policy we suggest. For SFTP, we provide a checksum + transfer log.
- Audit logging: our investigators add per-action entries and we can include a CSV of investigator IDs mapped to timestamps as part of the deliverables. We will add a clause to the SOW referencing per-step audit logs.
- SLA/exceptions and DoS: understood — we will remove broad language that might be read as authorization for DoS. Any traffic-impacting tests will be an explicit add-on and require written sign-off.
- Indemnity / liability: we can accept mutual indemnity for IP and data breaches with a liability cap; however, we need to confirm exact phrasing with our counsel. Our standard position is a cap at 12 months of fees for the engagement. If Acme or Redwood require a different cap, we can escalate.

Proposed schedule remains 2026-02-22 to 2026-02-26 for the main exercise. We can move by one week earlier/later if needed.

Attaching: evidence-transfer-proposal.txt (sample manifest + lifecycle), and an updated SOW highlighting the audit-log and transfer changes. If you and Olivia are available, let's schedule a 30m call Thurs 1/15 10am PT to confirm the final SOW language.

Best,
Ravi Kumar
Enterprise Sales, CypherSec
[Attachment: evidence-transfer-proposal.txt]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Team — thanks for the back-and-forth. I reviewed the updated SOW and the evidence-transfer proposal from CypherSec. A few procurement/legal notes before we lock dates:

Action items (Procurement / Legal):
- Procurement to issue a PO once CypherSec confirms final liability cap language in writing (we prefer 12 months of fees but will accept 24 months contingent on higher insurance limits).
- Legal to review the specific indemnity paragraph Ravi will send; request that CypherSec add the mutual-IP clause and a carve-out for subcontractor negligence.
- Security ops (Dev) to confirm the S3 upload bucket ARN and required IAM role for uploads — @Dev, please provide the ARN by EOD 1/22.
- Scheduling: hold 2026-02-22 to 2026-02-26 as tentative. If CypherSec confirms the liability language and the manifest template is acceptable, we will make it firm.

Contracts@acmecloud.com — copied so Acme has visibility into the evidence flow and retention window (90 days by default). If Acme needs longer retention, state the requested period before 1/22 so we can add it to the PO.

Marissa Cole
